name: usage-guard
description: Makes Claude aware of your claude.ai 5-hour and weekly usage limits: conserves budget as they approach, checkpoints and writes an agent-agnostic HANDOFF.md before the cutoff, and auto-captures state if the limit hits mid-task. Zero context cost while usage is normal.

wrapup_pct.title: Wrap-up threshold (%)
wrapup_pct.description: Usage % of any limit window at which Claude stops starting new work and hands off. The burn-rate projection can trigger it earlier.

critical_pct.title: Critical threshold (%)
critical_pct.description: Usage % at which Claude must hand off immediately.

notice_pct.title: Conserve threshold (%)
notice_pct.description: Usage % at which Claude starts working leaner (no broad exploration or subagents).

handoff_file.title: Hand-off file
handoff_file.description: Repo-relative path of the hand-off note any agent (Claude, Codex, a human) can resume from.

wrapup_policy.title: Wrap-up policy
wrapup_policy.description: incremental: write the hand-off early, then keep working in small committed steps until critical (uses the remaining budget). stop: hand off and stop starting work at wrap-up.

auto_commit.title: Commit a WIP checkpoint on hand-off
auto_commit.description: Ask Claude to commit its work-in-progress plus the hand-off note before the limit.

block_subagents.title: Block new subagents near the limit
block_subagents.description: Deny spawning subagents once wrap-up is reached; they would likely be cut off.

api_fallback.title: Poll the usage endpoint as a fallback
api_fallback.description: When the status line tap isn't installed, read limits from the same endpoint /usage uses (at most every 5 min, in the background).
